scope: Native Windows isolation and application-owned pipeline gate; installer deferred; Docker rejected. No project generated_tools content accessed or live app restarted.
security_limits: Generated code and unittest share an interpreter: child counts can be forged; no semantic correctness attestation.
AppContainer shares the host kernel; OS resources already accessible to AppContainers remain accessible.
Profile private storage is writable; no disk quota; staging time is outside execution deadline.
Only CPython standard library is staged; no third-party tool dependencies.
Unsupported hosts or setup/cleanup failures deny execution; no ordinary host fallback.
implemented: Native AppContainer no network capabilities; explicit inherited handles; minimal environment.
Job memory 512 MiB, eight processes, wall timeout 30 s, bounded combined output 256 KiB.
Read-only disposable staging; unique profile and copied runtime per invocation; cleanup.
Ledger owner, operation and length-framed source/test SHA256; independent non-executing syntax checks.
No empty, skipped, expected-failure, failed, changed, stale or missing observations accepted.
Manager final-stage and execution gates; explicit existing-tool reverification action.
incidents: EXEC-ERR-001 missing LOCALAPPDATA caused native Windows error 203; allowlisted required path.
FLOW-ERR-001 old CLI operation identity; bind new run ID.
FLOW-ERR-002 expected failures counted successful; reject.
FLOW-ERR-003 late result identity change; capture and compare.
FLOW-ERR-004 invalid source with unrelated tests; independent compile.
VERIFY-001 network test strengthened with live listener and parent connectivity control.
